description: This file defines the 'AdoNetBatchContainer' class, which implements the 'IBatchContainer' interface for the Orleans streaming provider using ADO.NET as the data storage backend. It manages serialization, event retrieval, and conversion to message payloads, supporting binary serialization optimized for database storage.

classes.name: AdoNetBatchContainer
classes.description: Implementation of IBatchContainer optimized for ADO.NET storage, supporting binary serialization and event management within the Orleans streaming framework.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, and request context.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specified type, associating them with sequence tokens.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into the current execution context.

methods.description: Creates an AdoNetBatchContainer instance from a message payload using a serializer.

methods.name: ToMessagePayload
methods.description: Serializes container data into a byte array suitable for message transmission.
